nodes.name: Filas de grupos (reemplazar por lectura de Excel)

parameters.query:
-- Paso 1: crea/actualiza SOLO el grupo (transacción propia).
-- Se ejecuta una vez por fila (item) que entra.
-- Parámetros:
--   $1 name, $2 description, $3 is_active, $4 is_doctor, $5 external_id
WITH input AS (
    SELECT
        $1::text                     AS name,
        NULLIF($2::text, '')         AS description,
        COALESCE($3::boolean, true)  AS is_active,
        COALESCE($4::boolean, false) AS is_doctor,
        NULLIF($5::text, '')         AS external_id
),
upsert_group AS (
    INSERT INTO public.groups (name, description, is_active, is_doctor, external_id)
    SELECT name, description, is_active, is_doctor, external_id FROM input
    ON CONFLICT (external_id) WHERE external_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE
        SET name        = EXCLUDED.name,
            description = EXCLUDED.description,
            is_active   = EXCLUDED.is_active,
            is_doctor   = EXCLUDED.is_doctor,
            updated_at  = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    RETURNING *
)
-- Devuelve la fila del grupo (plana): id, name, is_doctor, external_id, ...
SELECT * FROM upsert_group;

nodes.name: 2. Crear doctor + rol + asociar al grupo

parameters.query:
-- Paso 2 (solo si el grupo es doctor): registra/actualiza el usuario,
-- le asigna el rol de médico (role_id = 2) y lo asocia al grupo.
-- Todo en una sola sentencia = una sola transacción.
-- Parámetros (vienen de la fila del grupo ya creado):
--   $1 group_id (uuid), $2 name (nombre del grupo), $3 internal_id (external_id del grupo)
WITH doc AS (
    -- email ficticio 'no_email_<internal_id>@invokeia.com' para pasar la
    -- validación (email o teléfono requerido). Conflicto por internal_id.
    INSERT INTO public.users (name, email, internal_id, is_sales, is_active)
    VALUES (
        $2::text,
        'no_email_' || $3::text || '@invokeia.com',
        $3::text,
        true,
        true
    )
    ON CONFLICT (internal_id) DO UPDATE
        SET name        = EXCLUDED.name,
            internal_id = EXCLUDED.internal_id,
            updated_at  = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    RETURNING *
),
doctor_role AS (
    INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role_id)
    SELECT id, 2 FROM doc
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING *
),
link_group AS (
    UPDATE public.groups
        SET user_id    = (SELECT id FROM doc),
            is_doctor  = true,
            updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = $1::uuid
    RETURNING *
)
SELECT json_build_object(
    'group',  (SELECT row_to_json(g) FROM link_group g),
    'doctor', (SELECT row_to_json(d) FROM doc d),
    'role',   (SELECT row_to_json(r) FROM doctor_role r)
) AS result;
